notes.title: Node Farm - v1.6 - QoL update!
notes.notes:
Hello Node Farmers!

A new update is live - v1.6!

Those who are on my Discord server may know that I partly lost vision in one eye this month, which makes development much harder. According to my doctor, I should be fine in a few weeks.

I prepared a few improvements from my backlog (all based on your suggestions - thanks!) that were easy for me enough to make until I fully recovered.

Let's take a look at the changelog:

[h3] Changes [/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b]Improvement:[/b] recipe/resource in nodes config and boss selection can now be selected from the grid layout.
	[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Making a connection from the node to the empty space creates a road.
	[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] nodes in the shop are now more granularly split into new categories - buffs (per type), roads, logic gates/sensors, and crafters. Additionally - the shop is more compact.
	[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] A few tutorial improvements - kitchen, boiling, and salt are introduced when needed - not after checking a wiki.
	[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] It is possible to go back to the "save slots" from the "main menu"
[/list]

A short video showcasing the changes: 
[previewyoutube=34AgYc9o0us;full][/previewyoutube]

It will be the last update this year but don't worry - I am planning something big :D

Thank you all for your support, have fun, and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Node Farm - v1.5 - Analytics view + storage update!
notes.notes:
Hello Node Farmers!

Today I deployed a new major update - v1.5!
This time I focused more on Quality of Life improvements and the new feature - analytics/statistics view!

There is also an interesting experimental feature that can be enabled in the settings - resource transport between the storage clusters! More info below:

[h3] Major changes [/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b]New:[/b] analytics view added - now you can see the production/consumption/storage per island and globally (it is an additional view like "show connections" for example)
	[*] [b]New:[/b] analytics per node popup added - now you can see the production/consumption/storage when hovering over the node (it can be disabled in the settings)
	[*] [b]New:[/b] experimental feature - sending resources between the storage cluster added. If enabled - storage nodes that are not in the same cluster (a group of directly connected nodes of the same type) can send resources to other storage clusters (they couldn't do it before). It is disabled by default and can be enabled in the Settings menu.
[/list]

[h3] Minor changes [/h3]
[list]
    [*] [b]Improvement:[/b] in delete mode - when clicking on a node, without moving a mouse, you will delete only this one node (not all in a rectangle)
    [*] [b]Improvement:[/b] multiclicker and buffs can be placed on connections now
    [*] [b]Improvement:[/b] camera mode toolkit button added - it was not that clear that player can disable the ui (it was mentioned only in the wiki)
    [*] [b]Bug:[/b] multi-selected nodes were connecting to other selected neighbors if they were not connected - it worked while holding shift, but this behavior should be disabled anyway for the selected nodes - fixed
    [*] [b]Bug:[/b] eye dropper is selecting the wrong node in the utility category if the clickers are disabled - fixed
[/list]

A short video showcasing the changes:
[previewyoutube=3AhLGLW03xI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any questions/suggestions or would like to talk with me about the game, let me know on Steam Discussions or my Discord server! Also - let me know what would you like to see in this game! :)

Thank you all for your support and have fun!

notes.title: Node Farm - update v1.2 - IDLE Mode added + a lot of bug fixes/improvements
notes.notes:
Hello!

After a week of hard work, I am introducing a new update: v1.2!
This time I focused on implementing a new economy mode - "idle"!

After choosing the game mode (sandbox/roguelite/hardcore) you can choose if you would like to play the "classic" experience with a money cap or a new unlimited "idle" one with much faster growing node prices. What I can say after playing is that automation makes much more sense in this economy :)

In a few minor updates before, I was working on making the storage more efficient - it is also included in v1.2. Just as a lot of bug fixes and improvements based on your feedback!

Below is the full changelog from version 1.1 to 1.2:

[h3] Major Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New:[/b] Additional economy mode - "idle". The node prices grow much faster but there is no money cap!
[*] [b]Change:[/b] Storage has a priority now over producer nodes - if you have storage near your kitchens/crafters/seeds etc, resources will be taken from there if possible
[*] [b]Change:[/b] storage and fridge have more capacity
[*] [b]Change:[/b] the boss requires much more resources on high level islands
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] negation node didn't work correctly - fixed
[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Show selected resource icons on filters/price switch node graphics
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] When moving a group - small nodes were sometimes reconnecting on nearby connections in the group - fixed
[/list]

[h3] Minor Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] buffs didn't buff nodes on the edge of the island nearby - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] Sometimes pause was in an incorrect state after changing views and pressing ESC - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] dish icon on boss island selection didn't show on the island icon - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] price switch incorrectly indicated that it needs 2 connections - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] invisible collision boxes in the tutorial (where a shop should be) - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] dragging a camera is not colliding with the UI anymore - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] pressing ESC in "delete mode" didn't cancel it - fixed
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] Nori and Fish resources could also travel on the water roads - it made connection management annoying
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] Sometimes after ascending - the boss/standard island was displayed incorrectly
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] One-way road was blocking the path in specific connections - now it ignores the input direction. It looks much simpler
[*] [b]Bug:[/b] The game was not paused when entering the buy island/boss view - fixed
[*] [b]Change:[/b] Only LMB can click UI buttons - it fixes a few annoying issues related to accidental clicks
[*] [b]Change:[/b] tomato is no longer requiring wood - it is easy to soft lock with it
[*] [b]Change:[/b] minor changes in the nodes meta unlocks
[*] [b]Change:[/b] a few changes in the tutorial (more hints where needed)
[/list]

Thank you all for your feedback! I am working on more fixes and content (new nodes), so there will be a new interesting update next week :D
Have fun!

notes.title: Node Farm - update v1.1.1 - a lot of QoL fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you all for your feedback, I made a lot of fixes/improvements/changes according to it! Let's take a look at a changelog of update v1.1.1:

[h3]Major[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New[/b]: Block resource production if there are no available consumers waiting for it - no more waste!
[*] [b]New[/b]: Resource transport as resource icons, not dots - it is much easier now to see what is going on. The icons/dots display can be disabled/enabled in the settings.
[*] [b]New[/b]: A possibility to clear one specific resource in the chest - no need to clear all the storage if there are a few not-wanted resources.
[*] [b]New[/b]: an indication that a node is not connected - there will be a red frame around the node if it is not connected to anything and it should. I will be working on expanding this QoL feature more in upcoming patches! 
[*] [b]New[/b]: a cluster of storages synchronize to send resources one after another (not all storages at once as before). It makes the resources transport more efficient :)
[*] [b]Change[/b]: grabbing a node is faster by default and the grab speed can be configured in the settings - no more annoying waiting when playing without a keyboard! 
[*] [b]Bug[/b]: the game unpauses itself when clicking on a configurable node - it is fixed now!
[*] [b]Bug[/b]: performance - multithreading was not used for path calculation - it will work faster on bigger farms now
[*] [b]New[/b]: pressing ESC in the main menu goes back to the game if it exists
[/list]

[h3]Minor[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug[/b]: The boss can be rerolled - reroll removed on the boss island, it was useless
[*] [b]New[/b]: pressing ESC cancels "delete mode", and "show connection mode" (instead of going back to the main menu immediately)
[*] [b]New[/b]: pressing ESC cancels the warning (like the one when the player clicks "Ascend")
[*] [b]New[/b]: seed nodes connect automatically to other seed nodes
[*] [b]Change[/b]: pickled cucumber moved to the first page so the complexity on the beginning is less steep (instead of french fries that require oil)
[*] [b]Bug[/b]: performance - the game was recreating all graphics when changing views (frequent long loading time on big farms)
[*] [b]Bug[/b]: a fish food icon is displaying now
[/list]

[b]A short video:[/b]
[previewyoutube=NbL8dIRH0A4;full][/previewyoutube]

In the next updates, I am going to work more on QoL improvements, removing soft locks and alternative economy without a money cap. After the game will be stable, I will move forward to add more interesting content :)

As always, I am very happy to hear more of your feedback and improve the game as best as possible! It is a great help!

Thanks for playing!
ByerN
